scientific_integrity: Symbolic computation checks a finite list of degrees, not the infinite proof; geometric monodromy and Belyi branch partitions proved via explicit rational functions and ramification.
scientific_limitations: Only complex primitive trinomial supports {0,1,q}, q>=3, with epsilon nonzero and f squarefree. Geometric monodromy is for compactified covers; very-affine critical-point fibers exclude resonance. A classical equivalent Belyi passport is a residual literature-priority risk.
title: Three-branch-value collision geometry and full symmetric monodromy for sparse Euler critical points
